description:
Activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it.
When Catalyst Elemental dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Catalyst Elemental from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it.
When Catalyst Elemental dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Catalyst Elemental from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat
